matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: On COCO, YOLOv3 achieves an AP at IoU 0.5 comparable to RetinaNet while running roughly 3.8 times faster.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 achieves 57.9 AP50 in 51 ms compared to RetinaNet's 57.5 AP50 in 198 ms, making it 3.8× faster at similar performance.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 underperforms RetinaNet on the strict AP at higher IoU thresholds for medium and large objects despite being significantly faster.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 performance drops significantly as the IOU threshold increases, indicating it struggles to align boxes precisely with objects.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 predicts bounding boxes at three different scales using a feature pyramid built on a Darknet-53 backbone.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: YOLOv3 predicts boxes at 3 different scales using a concept similar to feature pyramid networks.
